entries.title: Job 15:1
segments: ¶Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:

entries.title: Job 15:2
segments: "Should a wise man answer with empty knowledge, And fill himself with the east wind?

entries.title: Job 15:3
segments: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, Or by speeches with which he can do no good?

entries.title: Job 15:4
segments: Yes, you cast off fear, And restrain prayer before God.

entries.title: Job 15:5
segments: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, And you choose the tongue of the crafty.

entries.title: Job 15:6
segments: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I; Yes, your own lips testify against you.

entries.title: Job 15:7
segments: "[Are] you the first man [who] was born? Or were you made before the hills?

entries.title: Job 15:8
segments: Have you heard the counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

entries.title: Job 15:9
segments: What do you know that we do not know? [What] do you understand that [is] not in us?

entries.title: Job 15:10
segments: Both the gray-haired and the aged [are] among us, Much older than your father.

entries.title: Job 15:11
segments: [Are] the consolations of God too small for you, And the word [spoken] gently with you?

entries.title: Job 15:12
segments: Why does your heart carry you away, And what do your eyes wink at,

entries.title: Job 15:13
segments: That you turn your spirit against God, And let [such] words go out of your mouth?

entries.title: Job 15:14
segments: "What [is] man, that he could be pure? And [he who is] born of a woman, that he could be righteous?

entries.title: Job 15:15
segments: If [God] puts no trust in His saints, And the heavens are not pure in His sight,

entries.title: Job 15:16
segments: How much less man, [who is] abominable and filthy, Who drinks iniquity like water!

entries.title: Job 15:17
segments: ¶"I will tell you, hear me; What I have seen I will declare,

entries.title: Job 15:18
segments: What wise men have told, Not hiding [anything received] from their fathers,

entries.title: Job 15:19
segments: To whom alone the land was given, And no alien passed among them:

entries.title: Job 15:20
segments: The wicked man writhes with pain all [his] days, And the number of years is hidden from the oppressor.

entries.title: Job 15:21
segments: Dreadful sounds [are] in his ears; In prosperity the destroyer comes upon him.

entries.title: Job 15:22
segments: He does not believe that he will return from darkness, For a sword is waiting for him.

entries.title: Job 15:23
segments: He wanders about for bread, [saying], 'Where [is it]?' He knows that a day of darkness is ready at his hand.

entries.title: Job 15:24
segments: Trouble and anguish make him afraid; They overpower him, like a king ready for battle.

entries.title: Job 15:25
segments: For he stretches out his hand against God, And acts defiantly against the Almighty,

entries.title: Job 15:26
segments: Running stubbornly against Him With his strong, embossed shield.

entries.title: Job 15:27
segments: "Though he has covered his face with his fatness, And made [his] waist heavy with fat,

entries.title: Job 15:28
segments: He dwells in desolate cities, In houses which no one inhabits, Which are destined to become ruins.

entries.title: Job 15:29
segments: He will not be rich, Nor will his wealth continue, Nor will his possessions overspread the earth.

entries.title: Job 15:30
segments: He will not depart from darkness; The flame will dry out his branches, And by the breath of His mouth he will go away.

entries.title: Job 15:31
segments: Let him not trust in futile [things], deceiving himself, For futility will be his reward.

entries.title: Job 15:32
segments: It will be accomplished before his time, And his branch will not be green.

entries.title: Job 15:33
segments: He will shake off his unripe grape like a vine, And cast off his blossom like an olive tree.

entries.title: Job 15:34
segments: For the company of hypocrites [will be] barren, And fire will consume the tents of bribery.

entries.title: Job 15:35
segments: They conceive trouble and bring forth futility; Their womb prepares deceit."
